about: Places in the private Reality Check, and the Bureau of Meteorology station each is checked against. dwo is the station's Daily Weather Observations file (www.bom.gov.au/climate/dwo/), which gives the official max, min, rain to 9am and 3pm wind. km is the straight-line distance from the place to the station. Chosen 27 Nov 2026: the nearest open station with daily records (Rainbow Beach, nearer Hook Point, stopped recording in Dec 2025).
